info.title: NessGate API
info.description: The open, neutral compatibility resolver for the agentic web. Given a domain, NessGate reads whatever that domain already publishes across the standard machine-discovery locations (llms.txt, ARD / ai-catalog.json, A2A agent card, RFC 9727 API catalog, ai-info.json, OpenAPI, Open Resource Discovery, AWP manifest, RFC 6415 host-meta) and returns one normalized answer, each record carrying a sourceUrl back to the domain. NessGate stores nothing, never crawls or indexes, and makes no ownership or safety claim. Read endpoints are public, unauthenticated, and CORS-open. The response contract is stable and additive: new optional fields may appear; clients must ignore unknown fields.

get.summary: Resolve a domain to the machine-readable resources it publishes
get.description: Reads what the domain itself publishes at the standard machine-discovery locations (llms.txt, ARD/ai-catalog, A2A agent card, RFC 9727 api-catalog, ai-info.json, openapi.json, Open Resource Discovery, AWP manifest awp.json, RFC 6415 host-meta) and returns one normalized answer. Provenance is always "self-published": each record carries a sourceUrl back to the domain so the caller can verify. "Found" means the location exists and its content parses (JSON, or non-HTML text); it does not assert protocol conformance. Nothing is stored or indexed; results are computed live and cached for 10 minutes.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Domain name, e.g. example.com. Scheme, path, port, and a leading www. are ignored; ASCII/punycode form required.

200.description: Observation complete. An empty discovered array is still a successful answer.

discovered.description: The routing map: which standards the domain publishes, and where.

resources.description: The normalized union of what those documents contain, flattened into one list.

checked.description: Every standard NessGate probed for, so an empty result is still informative.

400.description: Input is not a valid domain.

post.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 over the MCP Streamable HTTP transport. Stateless, no authentication. Exposes one read-only tool, discover_domain, which returns the same normalized answer as GET /discover/{domain}.

schema.description: A single JSON-RPC 2.0 message (initialize, tools/list, tools/call, ping).

405.description: GET is not supported; use POST.

Resource.description: A normalized record. NessGate reuses each source's own labels and adds source/sourceUrl.

source.description: Which standard this record came from.

sourceUrl.description: The native document the record was read from — authoritative; follow it to verify.

type.description: An open label taken from the source. Not a closed set.
